title: Professional summary
intro: Six years, four industries — automotive, healthcare, entertainment and government — each with a different bar for what "production-ready" means. My approach stays the same everywhere: understand the constraint before writing the component, build the reusable version instead of the one-off, and treat code review as part of shipping rather than a gate after it.
introMobile: Six years, four industries — automotive, healthcare, entertainment, government. Core approach: understand the constraint, build reusable components, treat code review as part of shipping, not a gate.
body: Day to day that means designing component libraries and state/data-fetching patterns teams can build on, testing the flows that carry money and personal data, and owning code review standards. I most recently mentored four engineers at Appinventiv, where the React, TypeScript and accessibility review standards I established were adopted team-wide.
